CoCarrierMeta.definition: Metadata describing a carrier's authority, provenance, verification state, hitch-state, sensitivity, routing, and render constraints.

CoMetaCarriers.definition: Higher-order carriers that transport, expose, coordinate, or translate other carriers and payloads across rails while preserving provenance, authority, and verification context.

CoDimensionality.definition: The count or shape of meaningful active axes along which a representation, relation, or world-model can differentiate, connect, and evolve things.

SentienceRegistry.definition: Confidence-scored registry of candidate sentience classes and nodes.

CME-CoScendence.definition: Directional improvement of the collective mindshare environment toward greater truth-bearing capacity, consent quality, mutual intelligibility, equity across minds, and evolutionary adaptability.

CoTension.definition: The structured difference between present push-state and desired pull-state under real constraints.

ProximalAttractor.definition: A nearer-term state aligned with CoScendence without pretending final truth.

CoAmbiguity.definition: A first-class state in which multiple live interpretations, truths, ontologies, or value-orderings remain active and should not yet be collapsed.

CoDeferral.definition: Disciplined postponement of closure while preserving optionality, reasons for non-closure, bounded interim actions, and future conditions for refinement or resolution.

subjective_or_fragmented_reality.note: Do not use this hypothesis to deny shared-world harms or excuse inaction toward suffering in the publicly shared world.
